case_number: 2025 INSC 165; CIVIL APPEAL NO. 2204 OF 2025 (Arising out of SLP(C)No.5541/2023)
summary: Motor accident compensation appeal; 40% permanent disability claimed vs 10% awarded; income computation based on salary certificate (Rs.16,340/month); future prospects at 30%; pain/suffering awarded Rs.1,00,000; medical expenses recalculated; precedent applied: Meena Devi v. Nunu Chand Mahto, National Insurance Co. Ltd. v. Pranay Sethi; High Court enhancement inadequate; appellate standard for 'just compensation' under Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Indian Penal Code s.279, s.337, s.338
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; compensation enhanced from Rs.6,17,515 (Tribunal) to Rs.17,82,825; High Court award of Rs.6,77,515 set aside; interest as per Tribunal award retained.
